provider.description: Issue provider CLI: gh (GitHub) or glab (GitLab)

workflow.description: workflow a new story starts in (default triage)

slice_workflow.description: workflow a new slice starts in (default slice)

norn_version.description: the norn version this repo needs, X.Y.Z (written by norn upgrade and norn init)

policy.description: local (default): the record stays on the holder's machine between claim releases; remote: every step boundary pushes it to refs/norn/runs/<story>

regenerate.description: generated files: path globs and the command that rewrites them, so a base update conflicting only in them needs no agent

paths.description: path globs, repo-relative, of the files `run` writes

run.description: shell command, run at the repo root, that rewrites those files; fast and deterministic

timeout.description: how long `run` may take, a duration like 2m (default 2m)
